text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I've already been asked where you 
were countless times by underclassmen 
looking for you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It seems your birthday will pass in high 
spirits once again this year, given how 
deeply respected and admired you are.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm honored by your kind words, but... I'm 
terribly sorry for all the trouble I'm 
causing you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, something of this level is nothing at 
all. It's just... hmm. How should I put 
this—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Utterly mortified... sweating buckets... 
Ah, never mind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if it is right before curfew, 
that is fine. Would you mind stopping by 
the student council room? I will make sure 
to leave it unlocked."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I know how busy you are, but still— it 
would be a shame if I couldn't hand over 
this birthday gift today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Go ahead and laugh at me for losing my 
composure. You can scold me for being 
selfish, too."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I've kept many of my juniors waiting, so 
as you said, it seems I will be cutting it 
close to curfew, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I will definitely be there, without fail.
